agenda.verbatim: Now it makes sense: go through six things, answer the crisis, review, execute. I like that it tells me exactly what Execute will do, that is what I want as a what-if player. But I do not like that the recommended answer to Xi hurts my own goal, and I would not know what 'meetings' means without reading twice. I would switch to Full desk after the first month; a table-top player wants to see everything and go at his own pace.
